articles.title: US stocks: Morgan Stanley turns bullish on global stocks, targets S&P 500 at 8,700
articles.description: Morgan Stanley has upgraded global equities to maximum overweight, citing favorable valuations for risk assets in the coming years. Earnings growth is anticipated to be the main driver for this expected rise, alongside stabilization in oil prices and interest rates.
